subject: Exec readiness: action sprint for leadership briefing
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Maggie Donovan <maggie.donovan@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: legal@acme.com
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec readiness: action sprint for leadership briefing

Team —

We have the leadership briefing on Jan 18 and the execs want a concise readiness packet by EOD Jan 12. To reduce last-minute asks, I want to run a focused action sprint this week. Please do the following by Jan 12 COB: 

- Owners: update the leadership readiness template (attached) with one-line status, top risk, mitigation, and ask. Keep each item to a single bullet line.
- Product asks / roadmap exceptions: call out any scope slippage or feature pull requests that need exec approval.
- Metrics: provide a single row for any metric change (latency, cost, unit economics) that would influence the ask.
- Blockers: be explicit if legal/security approvals are required (list the artifact + owner).

I'll consolidate into the one-page brief and surface any escalations to the exec sync on Jan 13.

Attachments: leadership_readiness_template.xlsx (template)

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Maggie Donovan <maggie.donovan@acme-analytics.com>, legal@acme.com
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec readiness: action sprint for leadership briefing

Lauren —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick updates (I updated the template and attached a working MAP for ACME):

> Owners: update the leadership readiness template (attached) with one-line status, top risk, mitigation, and ask.

- Customer health pack: DONE (one pager attached) — status: green; ask: approval to enable dedicated routing pilot for Q1.
- Mutual action plan (ACME): DRAFT attached as MAP_Acme_v2.pdf — Marissa owner; need legal to confirm clause on data retention.
- Roadmap exception: we have a request to delay the advanced reranking R1 to Feb due to dependency on quantization artifacts. Status: amber; ask: exec sign-off for 2-week slip.
- Blockers: legal needs a concise SOC2 evidence summary by Jan 11 for the marketplace contract. Legal@acme, can you confirm who on your side will take this?

I'll fill the template rows and flag anything that should escalate. My main open item is legal redlines and confirmation on the dedicated routing pilot budget.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v2.pdf

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Maggie Donovan <maggie.donovan@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec readiness: action sprint for leadership briefing

Lauren / Marissa —

Adding engineering context for the template rows (technical owners, SLO risk, and short mitigation):

> Roadmap exception: request to delay advanced reranking R1 to Feb due to dependency on quantization artifacts.

- Tech note: reranking R1 depends on the new 4-bit quant kernel. Current kernel validation: 75% coverage on our regression set; latency regression observed on sequences >2048. Owner: Karthik.
- Mitigation: scope a fallback using the 8-bit runtime on the pilot (adds +12ms p95). Need exec acknowledgement if that latency delta is acceptable for ACME pilot.
- Capacity: Vivek, can infra confirm if we can reserve burst capacity for the dedicated routing pilot (NVIDIA A30 pool) for the week of Jan 22? If not, we need to flag a procurement ask.

Reference: latency matrix (internal) — https://redwood.app/drive/exec-readiness/latency-matrix

I updated the template with the tech rows. If the execs want a precise p95 number for ACME's expected QPS, send me the forecast and I'll produce a short table.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Maggie Donovan <maggie.donovan@acme-analytics.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, legal@acme.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 17:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec readiness: action sprint for leadership briefing

Lauren / team —

Appreciate the heads-up and the template. We're aligning our internal stakeholders and can provide the Q1 usage forecast and SLA expectations by EOD Jan 12. Attach: ACME_forecast_Q1.csv (forecast + peak QPS).

Forwarding our legal contact to confirm SOC2 evidence; legal@acme.com will reach out to Redwood Legal to request the artifacts listed.

On the latency ask: the pilot will accept up to +15ms p95 for heavy sessions (we need the dedicated routing pilot to avoid user-visible regressions). If you can get a backup plan for the A30 capacity, that will be sufficient.

Thanks —
Maggie
Maggie Donovan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics
